children: Consumer Portfolio Services reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $7.0 million, up 43.3% year over year, and diluted earnings per share of $0.30, up 50%. Revenue increased 21.7% to $131.9 million. Contract purchases grew 108.5% to $815.3 million.
Third-quarter revenue was $131.9 million, up 21.7% from $108.4 million a year earlier. Revenue for the first nine months was $365.6 million, up 12.5%.
Expenses totaled $121.8 million in the quarter, compared with $101.4 million in Q3 2025; nine-month expenses were $338.5 million versus $304.3 million.
Third-quarter pretax income rose 44.3% to $10.1 million. Nine-month pretax income increased 30.3% to $27.1 million.
Third-quarter net income increased 43.3% to $7.0 million; nine-month net income rose 30.8% to $18.7 million.
Third-quarter diluted EPS was $0.30, up from $0.20. Nine-month diluted EPS rose to $0.80 from $0.59.
The company purchased $815.3 million in contracts during the quarter, up 108.5% year over year. Nine-month purchases increased 65.2% to $2.106 billion.
The owned loan portfolio reached a record $4.711 billion, up 25.3% from Q3 2025, marking 21 consecutive quarters of growth.
Total delinquencies, including repossession inventory, declined to 12.29% from 13.96%; annualized net charge-offs fell to 7.26% from 8.01%.
Net recovery rates on repossessed vehicles sold at auction rose to 32.0% from 28.7%.

Consumer Portfolio Services increased a warehouse line’s capacity to $508 million from $335 million. Its third asset-backed securitization of 2026 was its 110th and the largest in the company’s 35-year history.
